cards.hint: Think about national authority versus state authority.

cards.quote: Among the chief points at issue were how much power to allow the central government
cards.stem: What was one chief point at issue for delegates meeting through the summer?

cards.hint: Remember delegates waited until late May to begin work.
cards.quote: the members adjourned from day to day until a quorum of seven states was obtained on May 25.
cards.stem: What date marked the achievement of a quorum for conducting business?

cards.hint: Think about the earlier plan of government.
cards.quote: The Federal Convention convened in the State House (Independence Hall) in Philadelphia on May 14, 1787, to revise the Articles of Confederation.
cards.stem: What earlier plan did the Federal Convention first meet to revise?
